item.title: New website is live
item.description:
Welcome! This site collects my research on microbial fossilization, my publications, a web version of my CV, and photos from fieldwork. It is built with Quarto and hosted on GitHub Pages. Try the moon/sun toggle in the top bar to switch between dark and light mode.

item.title: Paper out in Scientific Reports
item.description:
Our study Experimental diagenesis reveals preservation of biosignatures in filamentous sulfur mats under hydrothermal conditions is now published in Scientific Reports (15, 38114).

We grew filamentous sulfur mats in the lab and exposed them to hydrothermal conditions to test which morphological and chemical biosignatures persist. See the Publications page for the full reference.

item.title: Talk at AbSciCon 2024
item.description:
I presented Forensic Astrobiology: Experimentally Assessing the Preservation of Microorganisms Encompassing Hydrothermal Vent Systems at the Astrobiology Science Conference (AbSciCon) 2024, together with J.-P. Duda, A. Kappler and M. Mansor.
